title: Climate Change Act, 2016 (Cap. 387A, No. 11 of 2016), as amended by the Climate Change (Amendment) Act, 2023 (No. 9 of 2023)
citation: Climate Change Act, 2016 (No. 11 of 2016), Cap. 387A; amended by Act No. 9 of 2023
evidence: Kenya Law page of the Act as at 15 September 2023: "Published in Kenya Gazette Vol. CXVIII—No. 52 on 13 May 2016 Assented to on 6 May 2016 Commenced on 27 May 2016 ... [Amended by The Climate Change (Amendment) Act, 2023 (Act No. 9 of 2023) on 15 September 2023 ]". Opened in a browser 2026-11-02.
notes: Link only: row KE-KENYALAW-CONSOLIDATED is permission requested (kenyalaw.org Terms of Use, notice dated 12 October 2026: copyright claimed under the Copyright Act Cap. 130, raw documents only under CC BY-NC 4.0, scraping, bulk download and AI training prohibited). No English-language government text exists elsewhere that passes: Parliament of Kenya (www.parliament.go.ke) states 'All rights reserved' and was not opened for this Act. Looked for a Swahili text on Kenya Law: only English (eng) expressions are listed. The 2023 amendment (15 September 2023) inserted Part IVA, Regulation of Carbon Markets (ss. 23A to 23I); Part IV s. 16 sets climate change duties of private entities and s. 22 reporting on climate change actions. Implemented by the Climate Change (Carbon Markets) Regulations, 2024 (ke-carbon-markets-regs-2024). The Kenya Law page lists a version at 31 December 2022 (24th Annual Supplement revision) and one at 15 September 2023.
status_note: Permission request to the National Council for Law Reporting not sent.

title: Code of Corporate Governance Practices for Issuers of Securities to the Public, 2015 (Gazette Notice No. 1420)
citation: Capital Markets Authority, Gazette Notice No. 1420, issued under Capital Markets Act (Cap. 485A) s. 11(3)(v), dated 15 December 2015
evidence: PDF on cma.or.ke (HTTP 200, 356766 bytes, application/pdf, 2026-11-02): "Dated the 15th December, 2015" with no commencement clause, so the issue date is used; s. 1.1.3: "Issuers are encouraged to implement this Code immediately but not later than one year after its publication in the Gazette."
notes: Link only: row KE-CMA-ADOPTED is permission requested (the CMA disclaimer grants no reuse right; footer 'All Rights Reserved'). The Code works on 'apply or explain', with mandatory provisions for issuers; the section 'Promoting sustainability' says "The Board shall have formal strategies to promote sustainability. Attention shall be given to Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) aspects of the business". The Gazette publication date was not stated in the PDF.
status_note: Permission request to the Capital Markets Authority not sent.
